name: 場所と日程と施設の種類をまとめる宿泊検索見出し
prompt:
Create one polished Japanese mobile lodging-search header for catalog ID LH01-0137, “場所と日程と施設の種類をまとめる宿泊検索見出し”. Use the original Booking.com screen as authority for control anatomy and order, and the Japanese mock as authority for localized copy, counts and brand-green adaptation.

Render one isolated horizontal header on a white canvas close to 390x216 proportion. Do not include a phone frame, status bar, blue page header, surrounding search results or unrelated content. Preserve this exact hierarchy:
1. A rounded, thin forest-green outline search field with a back chevron at left, then “東京、日本” and “3月17日〜19日”.
2. A row of three equally spaced outline-icon actions: sort arrows with “並べ替え”, filter sliders with “絞り込み”, and map-with-pin with “地図”.
3. A fine neutral divider.
4. Two horizontally aligned rounded-outline category chips: “ホテル 1,044件” and “貸切の宿泊先 1,678件”.

Keep all Japanese copy and numbers exact. Use the original icons’ familiar shapes: left chevron, vertical sorting arrows, three filter sliders, and folded map with location pin. Keep icons dark and consistent, with no decorative icon backgrounds. Use Meiryo Regular 14/24 px for the search text, Metadata 12/16 px for action labels and counts, tracking 0. Use ink #1D1D1D, a restrained Lighthouse Brand outline #1F6444 around the search field, pale neutral separators and pill borders, and pure white #FFFFFF surfaces. Keep compact mobile spacing, readable touch-sized controls, crisp baselines, and restrained rounding. Do not use orange, blue, gradients, extra filters, extra dates, or extra results counts.
reviewNotes: Agent visual review: exact copy, counts, icon actions and green outline are correct. Needs correction because the top search field starts about 20 px lower than the Japanese mock at 390x216. Move its top inset to about 16 px and preserve the remaining layout.
